question: What platform guidance applies to an AL job queue handler that exports records to an external HTTP API and that administrators must be able to rerun after a failure?
answer: Per microsoft/knowledge/performance/job-queue-handlers-must-not-require-ui.md, a job queue handler runs in a background session, so it must not use Confirm, Page.RunModal, upload or download, or rely on Message to report results. Per microsoft/knowledge/performance/job-queue-handlers-must-propagate-failures.md, an error that invalidates the run must propagate out of the entry point so the dispatcher marks the entry failed and applies its configured retry behavior. Catching a failure and returning normally reports success. Per-item failures may be collected only if the batch persists or emits an observable aggregate outcome. Per microsoft/knowledge/performance/job-queue-external-effects-must-be-idempotent.md, because retries, rescheduling or a manual restart can repeat the same work and the external request cannot be rolled back, a state-changing request needs a stable request ID that the external service enforces as unique. The external API's idempotency support was not supplied and is not answered here.
